answer: Anchor each identity to a chain of completed-job receipts signed by counterparties and bound to one hardware key, each receipt stamped by a quartz clock, like rings in a glacier core sample: the deeper the history, the harder it is to fake. A hollow identity with no receipts gets only trivial work, and receipts cannot be copied or transferred, so an attacker must genuinely perform months of verified work for every fake, while one honest agent pays nothing extra.
